name: flaggems_batch_norm_with_update
description: BatchNorm training op that normalizes input over N and spatial dims per channel, applies affine weight/bias, saves batch mean and inverse std, updates running_mean/running_var in place (mean uses biased var for invstd; running_var update uses unbiased variance), and returns a reserve buffer.
reference:
import torch

def gen_inputs(ctx, device):
    dtype = getattr(torch, ctx['input__dtype'])
    input = torch.randn(*ctx['input__shape'], dtype=dtype, device=device)
    C = ctx['input__shape'][1]
    weight = torch.randn(C, dtype=getattr(torch, ctx['weight__dtype']), device=device)
    bias = torch.randn(C, dtype=getattr(torch, ctx['bias__dtype']), device=device)
    running_mean = torch.zeros(C, dtype=getattr(torch, ctx['running_mean__dtype']), device=device)
    running_var = torch.ones(C, dtype=getattr(torch, ctx['running_var__dtype']), device=device)
    return {
        'input': input,
        'weight': weight,
        'bias': bias,
        'running_mean': running_mean,
        'running_var': running_var,
    }

def run(input, weight, bias, running_mean, running_var, momentum, eps):
    return torch.ops.aten._batch_norm_with_update(input, weight, bias, running_mean, running_var, momentum, eps)
